content.short: Walrus is a decentralized storage and data availability protocol on Sui designed for large-scale Web3 data storage.
content.description: Walrus is a pioneering decentralized storage and data availability protocol developed by Mysten Labs, the team behind the Sui blockchain. Specifically engineered to handle large "blobs" of data—such as high-fidelity videos, rich gaming assets, and AI datasets—Walrus achieves unparalleled levels of performance and cost-effectiveness. The network utilizes a novel encoding algorithm called RedStuff to ensure that data remains resilient and highly available even if storage nodes go offline. Walrus enables developers to build data-intensive applications previously impractical on-chain.
content.meta: Walrus provides high-performance decentralized storage and data availability. Discover Walrus and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Explorer.
